title: Civilizations switching on at the same time around 3000 BC

tellings.quote: that's exactly the same period that the engine of the Indus Valley civilization was switched on in what is now Pakistan

plain: The writer Graham Hancock tells Michels that early civilisations in Egypt, the Indus Valley in what is now Pakistan, and along China's Yellow River all seem to "switch on" at about the same moment, around 3000 BC. He says the Indus civilisation's "engine" started in "exactly the same period" as Egypt's, and he names no source. Hancock raises it as a hint that these cultures shared some older, lost inheritance.
